reasoning: 驗證 $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ 收到 8 時 TLM 顯示對應 popup。關鍵情境為單一回饋值之等價類（退出 Service Mode 相關分支）。本 Req 只述一個 Fdbk 值，依 §8.2.2 一 Req 一條。該值於 DBC 之 VAL_ 1486 無 label（只定義 0 與 31），依 §8.4.1 不造 label，寫 = 8 並於 Remarks 揭露。

tcs.tc_title: EPB Maintenance feedback = 8: park brake retracted
pre_conditions: The EPB Maintenance Mode menu item is displayed
The TLM is in the Vehicle Settings menu
test_procedure: Read the named UI element "Brake Service - Park Brake Retracted" and check that it is displayed
Read the signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ and check that it is 8
expected_result: The signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$ = 8 is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Brake Service - Park Brake Retracted" is displayed
tcs.test_item:
When the TLM receives the value 8 via signal, $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP2.EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk$, the TLM shall activate and display the popup: "Brake Service – Park Brake Retracted. To reset, press brake pedal and activate Park Brake switch."
(Fdbk = 8: park brake retracted reset instruction popup)

distinguishing_axis.delta: Fdbk 值 8（駐車煞車已收回），與同族其他 Fdbk 值為等價類之不同分割

tcs.remarks: DBC has no VAL_ entry for this raw value (VAL_ 1486 EPB_Maintenance_Fdbk defines 0 and 31 only), so no label is written
